description: This Java class 'WeightedPermission' models a permission with an associated weight used in policy enforcement, allowing for weighted decision-making based on permission importance.

classes.name: WeightedPermission
classes.description: Immutable class representing a permission with an associated weight, used for policy enforcement priority.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new WeightedPermission instance with validation on permission string.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the permission.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on permission and weight.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on permission and weight.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the weighted permission in the format '(permission, weight)'.
